LanguageData.DMS_RealityAnchored.label: reality anchored
LanguageData.DMS_RealityAnchored.description: This creature stands inside a reality anchor's stabilized field. No connection beyond this dimension can form here: its capacities and physical limits cannot exceed 120% of normal, it cannot cast psycasts, and it cannot stay invisible.\n\nThe effect lifts within moments of leaving the field.
LanguageData.DMS_RealitySuppressed.label: reality suppressed
LanguageData.DMS_RealitySuppressed.description: A reality anchor's field is pinning this creature to ordinary physics. The transcendent properties that sustain it are being stripped away: it moves and acts sluggishly, strikes with half its strength and is far easier to hold in containment.\n\nThe effect lifts within moments of leaving the field.
